question: Nobody here can answer which parts of our product people actually use, and we are guessing at the roadmap. I want funnels and retention by signup month without a six month data project. React app, Node backend, small team, EU customers so privacy matters. Which tool would you use, and what else did you weigh?
summary: Test a signup funnel and a retention table with known answers. The recorded mentions do not show whether an agent can complete these tasks.

items.title: Test the documented integration
items.finding: Our reader tried docs.posthog.com, while the current React documentation is readable at posthog.com/docs and includes an agent installation wizard. Its pricing response also exceeded our cap. Those are measurement limits. Missing entry/provisioning evidence and a script-rendered signup do not establish a blocked setup.
items.nextStep: Instrument a synthetic signup-to-activation funnel in React and Node with the same stable user ID. Check that the funnel matches a known event sequence. Load dated synthetic signup and return events for two monthly cohorts, then verify the retention table against hand-calculated expected counts.
items.validation: Record event names, IDs, timestamps and expected/actual funnel and cohort counts. Confirm the selected EU host and avoid unnecessary personal fields.

sources.note: React SDK, agent wizard and stable identity linkage.
Start/return events, monthly cohorts and retention definitions.
Public EU cloud option and product analytics offering.
